message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What Happens | |---------|--------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score **1,000 points** (or agree on a different target). Points are earned by being the first to empty your hand in each round. | | **Players** | 2–10 (standard deck). | | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue) × 25 cards each (one 0, two 1–9, two “Draw Two”, two “Skip”, two “Reverse”, two “Wild”, two “Wild Draw Four”). | | **Setup** | • Shuffle the deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face‑down as the draw pile.
• Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s an action card, apply its effect immediately (e.g., if a “Draw Two” starts the game, the first player draws two and loses the turn). | | **Turn Order** | Players sit in a circle. The first turn proceeds clockwise; a “Reverse” card flips the direction. | | **Playing a Card** | On your turn you may play **one** card that matches either the **color** or the **number/symbol** of the top discard. If you have no playable card, you must draw one from the draw pile. If that drawn card is playable, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Action Cards** | • **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and skips their turn.
• **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – Reverses play direction (acts like Skip if only two players).
• **Wild** – You choose the next color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – You choose the next color; next player draws four cards and skips their turn. (Can only be played if you have no other playable card; otherwise, the opponent can challenge.) | | **Calling “UNO”** | When you play your **second‑to‑last** card, you must say “UNO” before the next player takes their turn. Failure to do so (and being caught) forces you to draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The first player to discard all their cards wins the round. | | **Scoring** | • Winner scores points equal to the sum of the values of all cards still in opponents’ hands:
 – Number cards: face value.
 – Draw Two, Skip, Reverse: 20 points each.
 – Wild, Wild Draw Four: 50 points each.
• If the winner has no cards left (i.e., they just played the last card), they receive a **bonus of 100 points**. | | **Game End** | The game ends when a player reaches the target score (usually 1,000). If you’re playing a shorter game, you can stop after a set number of rounds or when a player reaches a lower score. | --- ### Quick Tips 1. **Keep a mix of colors** in your hand to avoid being stuck. 2. **Save Wild Draw Fours** for when you’re about to finish; they’re powerful but risky. 3. **Watch opponents’ “UNO” calls**—they’re a good indicator of how close they are to winning. 4. **Use “Reverse” strategically** to change the flow of the game, especially with two players. Enjoy the fast‑paced, colorful fun of Uno!
